sections.title: Cancellation Window
sections.content: Orders can be cancelled before shipment. Once shipped, cancellation is not possible; customer must follow return process. Cancellation requests after shipment must be politely declined with return instructions.

sections.title: Refund on Cancellation
sections.content: Cancelled orders are refunded to original payment method within 3-5 business days. Agent must confirm cancellation success and provide confirmation number.
